abilities.name: Tactical Strike
abilities.rawDescription:
After each Basic Attack, deal Tactical Damage to the original Basic Attack target at a 50% Damage Rate. Tactical Damage is increased by Kalspire's Instinct and mitigated by target Intelligence.

Additionally, independently check a 30% Bleed chance for the original target and one other Enemy within adjacency. Bleed lasts two rounds and deals Physical Damage each round at a 20% Damage Rate. Its Physical Damage is increased by Kalspire's Strength and mitigated by target Instinct.

At 6+ Stars, after each Basic Attack, also deal Physical Damage to one Enemy within adjacency that was not the Basic Attack target at a 25% Damage Rate. Physical Damage is increased by Kalspire's Strength and mitigated by target Instinct. Additionally, independently check a 15% Panic chance for that target and one other distinct Enemy within adjacency. The Panic targets must be distinct. Panic lasts two rounds and deals Tactical Damage each round at a 20% Damage Rate.

abilities.name: Champion's Brilliance
abilities.rawDescription: At Level 16+ and deployed in Vanguard: Kalspire Strength, Intelligence, and Instinct +15; Right Flank ally Damage Received -8%.

abilities.name: Robust Insight
abilities.rawDescription:
Start of Combat until end of combat: increase Kalspire's Strength and Instinct.

Habit Levels 1-5 — Strength increase: 20%, 24%, 28%, 34%, 40%. Instinct increase: 20%, 24%, 28%, 34%, 40%.

abilities.name: Battle Cunning
abilities.rawDescription:
Start of Combat until end of combat: reduce Strength and Intelligence of three Enemies in any lane. Both reductions are enhanced by Kalspire's Instinct.

Visible source discrepancy: the prose displays -6%, while the Level 1 table displays -6.5%.

Habit Levels 1-5 — Strength and Intelligence reduction (table): -6.5%, -7.8%, -9.1%, -11.05%, -13%.

abilities.name: Tactical Assault
abilities.rawDescription:
Augments Tactical Strike at 6+ Stars. After each Basic Attack, deal Physical Damage to one Enemy within adjacency that was not the Basic Attack target. Physical Damage is increased by Kalspire's Strength. Independently check Panic against that Physical Damage target and one other distinct Enemy within adjacency. Panic lasts two rounds and deals Tactical Damage each round.

Habit Levels 1-5 — Panic chance: 15%, 18%, 21%, 25.5%, 30%. Physical Damage Rate: 25%, 30%, 35%, 42.5%, 50%.

abilities.name: Dragon's Insight
abilities.rawDescription:
Start of Combat until end of combat: reduce Kalspire's Damage Received and increase Kalspire's Instinct.

Habit Levels 1-5 — Damage Received: -6%, -7.2%, -8.4%, -10.2%, -12%. Instinct increase: 12%, 14.4%, 16.8%, 20.4%, 24%.

abilities.name: Radiant Conqueror
abilities.rawDescription:
Start of Round 1: reduce Kalspire's Damage Received by 50% for one round and afflict Kalspire with Stun for one round. Stun prevents Commands, Habits, and Basic Attacks on the affected turn.

Start of Round 2: reduce non-Basic Physical Damage Dealt of the Enemy with the highest Strength and reduce Fire Damage Dealt of the Enemy with the highest Intelligence. Both effects last five rounds; the selected Enemies may be the same or different.

Habit Levels 1-5 — Physical and Fire Damage Dealt reduction: -10%, -13%, -16%, -20%, -25%.
